mechanism: Brimonidine ophthalmic is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause CNS depression and sedation, which may be additive with buprenorphine's opioid-induced CNS depression.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation and CNS depression; use brimonidine ophthalmic cautiously in patients on buprenorphine, though systemic absorption of ophthalmic brimonidine is minimal.
